selection: 25 vnc_sensory cells per rank tier (one tier per observation channel), ranked by direct synaptic weight onto vnc_motor; top 120 vnc_motor cells by direct weight from the chosen inputs; top 300 two-hop bridge cells by minimum incoming/outgoing contact strength. Ties by body ID. No game outcomes used.
assumptions: Engineered channel injection (rank tier, not named cell subtype identity). Simplified signed, normalized, leaky tanh rate units. Acetylcholine +1, GABA/glutamate -1; unknown and modulatory transmitters 0. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.
